title: Support/Resistance Inversion
description: Yesterday's support and resistance lines can invert.

title: Avoid News Days
description: Don't trade on news days or when news is expected.

title: 2-Test Rule
description: Wait for price to test levels twice (the 2-test rule).

title: Stop Loss Adjustment
description: Your stop losses are too defensive and should be better placed.

title: Wait for Clear Market Signals
description: Focus on clear signals, avoid small consolidations, and look for trends in lower timeframes if trends aren’t obvious in higher timeframes.

title: Orderblocks vs. FVGs
description: Order blocks are stronger than fair value gaps (FVGs).

title: Price Action
description: If BTC shows weakness, don't expect a retest of highs.

title: Trend Analysis
description: Identify if the trend is bullish or bearish for both BTC and the pair you're trading.

title: Mark Highs/Lows
description: Highlight the key high and low points.

title: Mark Supply/Demand Zones
description: Focus on important zones, especially on the 4H/1H chart.

title: Check Fib Levels & Volume
description: Always consider Fibonacci levels and volume.

title: Candlestick Patterns
description: Look at the last three candles, especially engulfing patterns, and ensure the asset has momentum and volume.

title: Reversals
description: Be cautious if a local high/low has barely been swept, as it's often followed by a reversal.

title: Liquidity Sweep
description: Look for anomalies in the chart before acting.

title: Purpose
description: Your goal is to make money, particularly to fund your wedding.

title: Buy Low, Sell High
description: Stick to buying when prices are low and selling when high.

title: Multi-Timeframe Analysis
description: Start with the 4H chart and scale down from there.

title: Trend Strength
description: Focus on strong trends or those showing sudden weakness.

title: Weak vs. Strong
description: Focus on weak performers rather than chasing those that are already moving up.

title: Mistakes
description: Avoid buying or shorting in overly green (bullish) or red (bearish) conditions—like the mistake made with PEPE yesterday.
